description: Test class for SynchronousCommandProcessingService, verifying command execution flow, retry logic, error handling, and idempotency in different scenarios.

classes.name: SynchronousCommandProcessingServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for verifying the behavior of SynchronousCommandProcessingService under various scenarios including retries, errors, and success cases.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes Mockito mocks, sets up request context, configures retries, and prepares environment before each test.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Resets mocked dependencies after each test.

methods.name: testExecuteCommandSuccessAfter2Fails
methods.description: Tests that command execution succeeds after two retryable failures, verifying retry logic and state updates.

methods.name: executeCommandShouldFailAfterRetriesWithIdempotentCommandProcessUnderProcessingException
methods.description: Verifies that when a command remains under processing for maximum retries, appropriate exception is thrown.

methods.name: executeCommandShouldPassAfter1retryFailsByIdempotentCommandProcessUnderProcessingException
methods.description: Tests that a command initially under processing can eventually be successfully processed after retries.

methods.name: testExecuteCommandSuccess
methods.description: Validates successful command processing without retries or errors.

methods.name: testExecuteCommandFails
methods.description: Checks that runtime exceptions during processing are properly propagated and logged.

methods.name: publishHookEventHandlesInvalidJson
methods.description: Ensures that invalid JSON in hook event publishing does not throw unhandled exceptions.

methods.name: testExecuteCommandWithRetry
methods.description: Simulates transient errors during command save, verifying retry logic and eventual success.

methods.name: testExecuteCommandWithMaxRetryFailure
methods.description: Simulates persistent failure during save, ensuring max retries are respected and exception is raised.
